pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Channo anācāraṃ ācarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.7: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Channo bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhati:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.11: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Channa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.15: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vakkhasi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.17: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.18: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.19.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno evaṃ vadeyya: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharaṃ paripucchāmīti, pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:1.20: sikkhamānena bhikkhave bhikkhunā aññātabbaṃ paripucchitabbaṃ paripañhitabbaṃ, ayaṃ tattha sāmīcīti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.8: yaṃ bhagavatā paññattaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ etaṃ sahadhammikaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.1.9: tena vuccamāno evaṃ vadeti: na tāvāhaṃ āvuso . . . vinayadharan ti paṇḍitaṃ byattaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.3: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī evaṃ vadeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.5: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhūtattāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na viriyārambhāya saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti, na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi, yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharan ti paṇḍitaṃ byattaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.6: anupasampannena paññattena vā apaññattena vā vuccamāno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc71:2.2.7: idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhūtattāya . . . saṃvattatīti evaṃ vadeti, na tāvāhaṃ āvuso etasmiṃ sikkhāpade sikkhissāmi yāva na aññaṃ bhikkhuṃ byattaṃ vinayadharan ti paṇḍitaṃ byattaṃ medhāviṃ bahussutaṃ dhammakathikaṃ paripucchāmīti bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
